mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but 20-day SPX returns are negative in >60% of instances over 2019-2024.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market contraction below 4.0% unemployment rate signals reduced economic slack, increasing equity demand and producing positive 5-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0 but 5-day SPX returns are negative in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust supply chain capacity and consumer demand, generating positive 20-day SPX returns through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: INDPRO and HOUST both rise but 20-day SPX returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, elevated housing starts (HOUST > 1250) indicate sustained consumer spending, driving positive 60-day SPX returns via momentum effects.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1250 during late-cycle but 60-day SPX returns are negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value below 256.0 indicates subdued inflation, prompting central bank policy stability that supports equity valuations and produces positive 20-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL < 256.0 but 20-day SPX returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 20,000) reflects robust economic activity, increasing corporate earnings expectations and generating positive 60-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 20,000 but 60-day SPX returns are negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 151,000 (thousands) signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and driving positive 5-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 151000 but 5-day SPX returns are negative in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates manufacturing resilience, supporting corporate margins and producing positive 20-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 but 20-day SPX returns are negative in >60% of instances.
